text_block_list.text:
Searching for the missing "something" 
needed for the Arima Kinen, Agnes Tachyon 
comes to realize that what she needs is a 
"rival."

One day, after training alongside 
Manhattan Cafe, Agnes Tachyon developed a 
strong desire not to lose to her of all 
people.

After mulling it over, Agnes Tachyon 
realizes that Manhattan Cafe is someone 
special to her... a "rival."

Later. In an interview, Agnes Tachyon 
stated that she was looking forward to 
running in the Arima Kinen alongside her 
"rival."
